questions.question: In the summary, what does “zero‑trust architecture” mean?
options: A method for guaranteeing zero financial losses
A system that never allows any external connections
A type of building design for data centers
A security model that assumes no user or device is trusted by default
questions.explain_en: Zero‑trust architecture means you treat every user, device, and network as untrusted until it is verified, so security checks are applied everywhere.
questions.explain_zh: 零信任架構指的是在任何使用者、裝置或網路被驗證前，都不假設其可信，必須在每個環節都進行安全檢查。

questions.question: According to the new cyber rules, what is required of financial CISOs?
options: They must reduce the number of banks they oversee
They must eliminate all software updates
They must move all data to overseas servers
They must have clearly defined responsibilities
questions.explain_en: The summary states that the new cyber rules define responsibilities for financial CISOs, meaning their duties must be clearly outlined.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明，新網路規則為金融資訊安全長（CISO）規定了明確的職責，必須清楚界定其工作內容。
questions.news_title_en: FSC Keeps "Safety and Development in Parallel," Puts Anti-Fraud and Cyber-Resilience First

questions.explain_zh: 「tightening」指的是縮減貨幣或信貸供給的政策，例如升息或賣出資產。
